_how_it_works: Culture comparison widgets (Mohamed's culture-only topic, Bodour Al Qasimi, Al-Mayassa Al Thani). Same roles as registry.json; files in widgets_culture/.

topic_totals.title: Mentions, potential reach, media value (Culture)
topic_totals.needs: Topic; Mentions, Overall reach (shown as potential reach), Reach count, EMV. All sources.
topic_totals.run: per period: 7D, 30D, 90D, YTD with comparison periods
topic_totals.note: Sent with topic tag Plain; the refresh reads the three culture topics by ID, so the tag does not change the result.

topic_share.title: Share of voice (Culture)
topic_share.needs: Topic; Mentions. All sources. Cross-checks the totals.
topic_share.run: per period: 7D, 30D, 90D, YTD with comparison periods
topic_share.note: Sent with topic tag Plain; the refresh reads the three culture topics by ID, so the tag does not change the result.
